attempts.hypothesis: Explicit shape regimes may capture kernel-dependent instruction costs missed by polynomial work estimates. The two remaining regimes—medium initial chunks and small temporal chunks—have similar observed total costs and share the fitted baseline.

pcvs.name: initial_small_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Separates initial chunks below the medium spatial size into their own execution regime.

pcvs.name: initial_large_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Separates large initial chunks, whose instruction scaling remains poorly explained by area.

pcvs.name: temporal_medium_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent cost for medium spatial inputs with multiple temporal frames.

pcvs.name: temporal_large_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Allows an independent cost for large spatial inputs with multiple temporal frames.

attempts.hypothesis: This candidate retains six distinct states, correcting the previous validity failure. It models initial chunks with spatial area while allowing independent costs for all three multi-frame spatial regimes.

pcvs.name: temporal_chunk
pcvs.rationale: Provides a separate baseline for multi-frame chunks.

pcvs.name: temporal_medium_spatial
pcvs.rationale: Captures the medium multi-frame execution regime independently.

pcvs.name: temporal_large_spatial

attempts.hypothesis: A populated-cache flag hides differences between the first continuation and later continuations. Actual cached element and frame cardinalities may explain variation that remains even with explicit input-shape regimes.

pcvs.name: spatial_sites

pcvs.name: input_sites
pcvs.rationale: Models computation proportional to input temporal volume.

pcvs.rationale: Measures cached tensor volume using metadata, distinguishing partially filled histories from mature histories.

pcvs.name: cached_frames
pcvs.rationale: Captures cache occupancy and temporal history lengths that affect concatenation, padding, and short-history branches.

attempts.hypothesis: Detailed cache and categorical predictors increased irregularity. A compact model with one combined spatial-temporal work term and one execution-path offset may fit more robustly; the combined term gives multi-frame chunks three times the spatial work of initial chunks.

pcvs.name: effective_spatiotemporal_work
pcvs.rationale: Combines temporal work in the early encoder stages with spatial work in later stages into one predictor.

pcvs.name: temporal_chunk
pcvs.rationale: Captures the additional fixed overhead of cached multi-frame execution.

attempts.hypothesis: The combined work predictor lost most explanatory power, suggesting separate kernel loop bounds are necessary. Independent area, temporal volume, spatial perimeter, and frame count restore these bounds without imposing proportionality between their costs.

pcvs.name: spatial_area
pcvs.rationale: Provides the direct spatial loop bound for convolution and elementwise kernels.

pcvs.name: temporal_volume
pcvs.rationale: Provides an independent temporal-volume bound rather than imposing a shared coefficient with spatial work.

pcvs.name: spatial_perimeter
pcvs.rationale: Models row traversal and padding boundaries independently of temporal length.

pcvs.name: chunk_frames
pcvs.rationale: Models temporal loop overhead and distinguishes initial from continuation chunks.
